solution_steps: Register a baker account to obtain a session cookie
Create a recipe with 300 ingredients, exploiting the cookie/ingredient overflow so that an injected 'role=chief' attribute survives into the reviewer context
Submit the recipe for review so the automated Quality Inspector loads it (overflow evicts the ordinary role cookie and the injected 'role=chief' takes effect)
Once the batch is stamped with the Chief's Golden Seal, the reward flag is rendered on the recipe page
